title: External Video Ingest Manifest V2
description: Versioned external capture-group manifest. Video declarations are upload intent, not proof of receipt. Declarations may be added only while the manifest remains ACCEPTED and unbound; after BOUND the manifest is immutable. Actual receipt is finalized separately from bound ClipAsset/CameraStream facts, never inferred from timeout.

videos.description: Explicit video upload intent. It may be a strict subset of expected_camera_numbers; a declaration is not proof that bytes or a ClipAsset/CameraStream have been received.

upload_set_finalized.description: Explicit upstream close signal. It is accepted only after the bound upload has produced a CaptureSession; false keeps the receipt RECEIVING, and true closes it as COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE from actual bound camera facts. The dedicated CaptureGroup receipt-finalize command is the preferred operation.

capture_group_key.description: Stable upstream group identity. It is never inferred from filename, timing or upload order.

captured_at.description: Upstream capture declaration; it is not used to infer camera identity or group membership.

expected_camera_numbers.description: Stable display numbers. A missing expected number remains missing and is never renumbered.

camera_number.description: Stable camera number. A camera can be declared once; a retry must retain the same digest and file facts.

record_start_at.description: Optional upstream stream-start declaration. It is not a camera identity key and is not grouped by time proximity.
